tasks.title: Prepare and verify authoritative source pack
tasks.acceptance: Raw sources are readable, hashed, registered, and mirrored for deterministic reads.

tasks.title: Audit and finalize the learner and language policy
tasks.acceptance: Learner scope, MSA policy, English/Arabic roles, and exclusions are explicit with contradictions resolved or logged.

tasks.title: Define observable mastery and progress states
tasks.acceptance: A reusable rubric distinguishes completion, demonstration, review need, and retention.

tasks.title: Define bounded AI teacher and teach-back behavior
tasks.acceptance: Turn flow, correction, retry, ending, safety, and teach-back hypotheses are testable and concise.

tasks.title: Review and pass the learning-model gate
tasks.acceptance: Independent critique finds no unresolved issue that would change the gold lesson's basic shape.

tasks.title: Define the source-record schema and validation rules
tasks.acceptance: Schema preserves verbatim text, source location, skill/mode, level, interpretation, and review state.

tasks.title: Extract A1-relevant GSE adult objectives
tasks.acceptance: All included GSE A1 records are parsed, counted, deduplicated, page-cited, and validation-clean.

tasks.title: Extract supporting CEFR A1 descriptors
tasks.acceptance: Relevant A1 descriptors across modes are captured verbatim with scale and page provenance.

tasks.title: Normalize skills, modes, and communicative functions
tasks.acceptance: Controlled tags are documented; source wording remains unchanged; ambiguous cases are flagged.

tasks.title: Create candidate objective clusters and unit map
tasks.acceptance: Every included objective maps naturally or is explicitly flagged; seven earlier units are tested, not forced.

tasks.title: Run coverage, duplicate, prerequisite, and skill-balance audit
tasks.acceptance: Coverage is complete, exclusions justified, duplicates reconciled, and skill gaps documented.

tasks.title: Define lesson-sized ability rules
tasks.acceptance: Merge/split criteria and a measurable-outcome template are approved.

tasks.title: Create and audit the final A1 lesson map
tasks.acceptance: Lessons are coherent, source-linked, sequenced, balanced, and individually assessable.

tasks.title: Select the gold lesson and assemble its source packet
tasks.acceptance: Selection is justified and its objectives, grammar, vocabulary, phrases, pronunciation, and errors are traceable.

tasks.title: Author the complete gold-lesson content specification
tasks.acceptance: The full learning loop, AI behavior, mastery task, review items, and asset briefs are present.

tasks.title: Run independent pedagogy, level, Arabic, and source QA
tasks.acceptance: No major defect remains and all medium findings have owners.

tasks.title: Create prototype, protocol, consent, and success thresholds
tasks.acceptance: A clickable test and ethical observation protocol can evaluate the important hypotheses.

tasks.title: Run learner tests and synthesize evidence
tasks.acceptance: Observed results, failures, revisions, and go/no-go decision are documented.

tasks.title: Lock versioned lesson, exercise, AI, mastery, and review contracts
tasks.acceptance: The revised gold lesson fits reusable schemas without one-off exceptions.

tasks.title: Design and spike the technical architecture
tasks.acceptance: Stack, PostgreSQL model if selected, privacy model, media pipeline, and thin vertical slice pass review.

tasks.title: Build and pilot the complete first unit
tasks.acceptance: Multi-lesson progression, review, mastery, reliability, accessibility, and pilot criteria pass.

tasks.title: Scale the validated factory to full A1
tasks.acceptance: Full A1 passes source, level, Arabic, pedagogy, media, technical, and release audits.
